zh: 以多参数选择器列表结尾的样式规则在构建时展开成按类名、属性或标签匹配的几条，浏览器不再拿它们去试页面上的每个元素；六千节点的页面上，皮肤样式表下的一次样式计算从 28.7 毫秒降到 22.5 毫秒
en: Style rules ending in a multi-argument selector list are written out at build time into rules matched by class, attribute or tag, so the browser no longer tries them on every element; on a 6,000-node page one style calculation under the skin's sheet drops from 28.7 ms to 22.5 ms
